title: perf(desktop): stop re-reading preferences.json on every IPC call (audit LIB-A3)
body:
## What changed and why

`vaultDirectory()` read and parsed `preferences.json` synchronously on the Electron main thread on every call — every Library IPC handler and every media request (about 2n reads per list, ~50 ms blocked at n=500). Audit finding **LIB-A3** (`apps/documentation/src/content/docs/audits/2026-10-15/findings/library-a.md`), plan `plans/audit-2026-10-15/11-vault-directory-cache.md`, approved spec `specs/2026-10-28-niw2-394-vault-directory-cache.md` (first commit on this branch).

Only `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/library/vault-location.ts` changes:

- The parsed preferences are cached in module state, **keyed by the preferences file path**, so a different `userData` dir never sees another dir's value.
- `vaultDirectory()` reads from the cache: after the first call it never touches the disk.
- `setVaultDirectory` / `resetVaultDirectory` re-read the file from disk (so keys added by hand are merged, not clobbered), write atomically as before, and refresh the cache **only after the rename succeeds** — a failed write throws and leaves the previous value.
- The signature stays synchronous; no caller changes.

**Behaviour change:** a hand edit of `preferences.json` while the app runs is no longer seen by reads. It is picked up on the next app start, and its other keys are merged into the next choose/reset write. Before, a hand edit took effect on the very next call.

The PR also deletes the shipped plan file and its row in `plans/audit-2026-10-15/00-index.md` (status now 12 of 36 shipped).

### Tests (written first, run red before the fix)

Five new cases in `vault-location.test.ts`; the existing three are unchanged:

| Test | Before the fix |
| --- | --- |
| serves later reads from memory (hand edit to `/b` after `set("/a")` is not seen) | **failed** (returned `/b`) |
| a set after a hand edit merges the file's other keys | passed (regression guard) |
| reset after a hand edit drops only `vaultDirectory` | passed (regression guard) |
| a failed write (userData dir removed) throws and keeps the previous value | **failed** (fell back to the default) |
| a different userData dir does not see another dir's cache | passed (guards the cache key) |

## How I verified it

- `apps/kaipu-record/node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/main/library/vault-location.test.ts` before the fix → 2 failed / 6 passed; after → 8/8.
- `apps/kaipu-record/node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/main/library` → 13 files, 128 tests passed.
- `bun run verify` (workflows check, lint, oxfmt, build, check-types, all tests) → green, run twice in a row.
- Playwright desktop E2E not run locally (CI runs it).

## How to test it yourself

1. Open the Library with many items → behaviour unchanged, it lists at least as fast (with plan 01's `library_listed` event, `ms` drops by roughly 2n × 50 µs).
2. Settings → Files → pick a new folder → the Library lists the new folder and posters load; Reset → the default folder is back.
3. Quit, hand-edit `vaultDirectory` in `preferences.json` (in the app's userData dir), relaunch → the edit is honoured.

Refs NIW2-394
